summary: R306 is a narrow Paper 15 printed-p.148 source repair on top of R305. It corrects the exponent in the two-row case from carried `\nu` to source-visible `x` in two places: `F=c\,\xi_{12}^x` and `c\,(12)^x\equiv0\pmod p`. The cumulative German TeX/PDF builds with XeLaTeX and remains 474 pages.
global_caveat: Targeted two-token Paper 15 support only. The staged page image is a 650dpi render from GDZ material whose native quality is about 400ppi; the 1000-equivalent crops are readability aids only. This is not Paper 15 certification, Noether closure, multilingual synchronization, whole-corpus source closure, or critical-edition material. R307 is now packaged and registered separately as the next current-control patch; R306 remains provenance immediately before R307.
